definitions.full: H3456. yasham [ יָשַׁם ] verb be desolate (compare שָׁמַם ) — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular תֵּשַׁם Ezek 12:19 ; תֵּשָׁ֑ם Gen 47:19 ; וַתֵּ֫שַׁם Ezek 19:7 ; 3 feminine plural תִּישָׁ֑מְנָה 6:6 (Co תֵּשׁמנה ); — be desolate , subject ארץ 12:19 ; 19:7 ; subject אֲדָמָה Gen 47:19 (J); subject במות Ezek 6:6 .
